name: Levi and the originals
source:
Levi has taken custody of five children who have lost some of their memories and has taken on the mission of trying to restore them, but what else could be going on?

[From [url=https://ingred46sisu.itch.io/levi-and-the-originals-demo]Itch.io[/url]]

Levi收留了五個失去部分記憶的孩子，並肩負起幫助他們恢復記憶的使命。不過，這背後還發生著什麼？
